settings.profile.languageHint: Applies to all accounts and workspaces in this app.
settings.profile.languagePartialNotice: Screens that are not yet translated appear in Korean.
settings.profile.languageLoadError: Could not load the language. Please try again.
settings.appearance.linkPreviewCompactHi: Shows a small picture on the left, with the address, a one-line title and a one-line description on the right.
settings.appearance.linkPreviewRichHint: Puts the text on top and a large picture below, with up to two lines of title and description. Links without a large picture look like Small.
settings.appearance.linkPreviewOffHint: Keeps only the link in the message and draws no card.
settings.aiLimits.title: Usage limits
settings.aiLimits.description: Limits on what the helper uses. There is no limit by default, because your team pays for its own key and decides. You can turn on a daily or monthly limit.
settings.aiLimits.stopHint: When it is reached, the helper stops and offers a button to hand the request to another agent.
settings.aiLimits.searchHint: When it is reached, the helper answers without web search until the next reset.
settings.aiLimits.pricingNote: Calculated from public prices. It can differ from your provider's invoice.
settings.aiLimits.ceilingTokens: The server operator capped this at {limit, number} tokens a day.
settings.aiLimits.ceilingSearches: The server operator capped this at {limit, number} searches a day.
settings.aiLimits.operatorOff: The server operator has paused the team AI.
settings.aiLimits.operatorSearchOff: The server operator has turned web search off.
settings.aiLimits.usdModelUnpriced: The model in use has no known price, so a spending limit can't be turned on. Try a token limit.
settings.aiLimits.usdNoUsageYet: You can turn this on after the helper has answered once.
settings.aiLimits.usdInactive: The model in use has no known price, so this spending limit is not being applied. Consider a token limit as well.
settings.aiLimits.usdUnpricedRuns: {count, plural, one {# request} other {# requests}} on a model with no known price {count, plural, one {is} other {are}} not counted in the amount.
settings.aiLimits.errorInvalidCount: Enter a whole number of 1 or more.
settings.aiLimits.errorInvalidUsd: Enter an amount above 0, with up to six decimal places.
settings.aiLimits.errorZero: 0 can't be used as a limit. To remove the limit, turn the switch off.
settings.aiLimits.errorOverCeiling: You can enter at most {max, number}, the limit the server operator set.
settings.aiLimits.saveFailed: Couldn't save the limit. Check your connection and try again.
settings.aiLimits.saveForbidden: Only owners and admins can change limits.
settings.aiLimits.usdUnavailableNow: A spending limit can't be turned on right now.
settings.aiLimits.offline: You're offline, so limits can't be changed right now.
settings.aiLimits.rowHint: Set daily and monthly limits on helper usage and see how much is used.
settings.aiLimits.notAdmin: Only owners and admins can see this.
settings.aiLimits.unsupported: This server doesn't support usage limits yet.
settings.notifications.threadReplyDescri: New replies from others in threads you follow.
